title: Drive Your Friends Insane
description: This datapack will drive your friends crazy by doing various pranks.
body:
This Datapack Will Drive Your Friends Crazy!
Pranks include:
Turning them to adventure mode for 5 seconds,
Placing a barrier block in front of them for a split second,
Playing creeper noises,
Making entities disappear,
Giving them seeds,
Removing items in their inventory,
Revoking all advancements,
Damaging them by half a heart,
Turning them around,
Spawning skinwalkers behind them,

give yourself the tag 'safe' to be immune
